annotations.title: Income statement, balance sheet: by ticker

description: Income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement of a US-listed company by ticker: revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, R&D, operating income, net income, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash and debt, operating cash flow and capex, annual or quarterly, read from its SEC 10-K and 10-Q XBRL filings. Use to read a company's financial statements without parsing the filing. Example: ticker=AAPL. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (instead of ticker)

ticker.description: Stock ticker or company name, e.g. AAPL (or give cik)

name: income_statement
